cases.description: `invoices.record` sends POST /api/companies/cmp0000001/invoices with the JSON body and an automatic Idempotency-Key, and returns the outcome.
`invoices.cancel` sends POST /api/companies/cmp0000001/invoices/01J90000000000000000000116/cancel with the JSON body and an automatic Idempotency-Key, and returns the outcome.
`invoices.issue` sends POST /api/companies/cmp0000001/invoices/01J90000000000000000000116/issue with the JSON body and an automatic Idempotency-Key, and returns the outcome.
`invoices.revise` sends POST /api/companies/cmp0000001/invoices/01J90000000000000000000116/revise with the JSON body and an automatic Idempotency-Key, and returns the outcome.
`parties.create` sends POST /api/companies/cmp0000001/parties with the JSON body and an automatic Idempotency-Key, and returns the outcome.
`files.list` sends GET /api/companies/{company_id}/files/ and returns the first page.
`files.retrieve` sends GET /api/companies/{company_id}/files/{file_id}/.
`files.upload` sends a multipart body with the file and the fields the caller set.
`files.download` sends GET .../content/ with Accept */* and no format parameter, and gives the bytes.
